purpose: ONE owning source for public surface names, internal modes, legacy namespaces, and FORBIDDEN public aliases (owner canonical operating interpretation, 2026-07-01). Product-facing copy is linted against this registry by scripts/check_surface_naming.py — a forbidden alias in a product surface fails unless the same line marks it legacy/internal. Lowercase path/script namespaces (e.g. `aidevexplorer`) are legacy implementation details, allowed until a deliberate migration removes them.
portfolio_sentence: AI Done Right is the portfolio. AIDevObserver is the customer-facing speed-and-reuse layer for AI coding sessions. Teleon compiles reusable primitives and templates into deterministic, proof-backed capability routes. Baltor governs verified context. OpenHubForAI is the reusable component registry. The AIDevObserver Benchmark Lab is an internal/eval harness, historically named `aidevexplorer` in some paths, not a branded public surface.
